title: HVAC Consultancy & Design
summary: Practical HVAC planning for basement ventilation, factories and office air conditioning.
description: CES translates building use, heat loads, occupancy and operating priorities into coordinated HVAC concepts and buildable technical documentation.
system: The design scope connects heat-load assessment, fresh-air requirements, zoning, equipment selection, duct and piping routes, electrical interfaces and control intent into one coordinated system.
completeSolution: From the first site discussion through drawings, quantities and execution support, CES provides one technical reference for informed project decisions.

title: Ventilation & Air Conditioning
summary: Integrated ventilation, ducting, fan installation and centralized cooling for occupied buildings.
description: CES delivers air movement and cooling systems that respond to occupancy, heat generation, fresh-air demand and the physical constraints of the building.
system: Fans, ducts, dampers, grilles, cooling equipment, piping, controls and electrical interfaces are coordinated as one airflow and comfort system.
completeSolution: CES coordinates design, supply, installation, testing and balancing so the delivered airflow matches the intended operating condition.

title: Chiller Plants
summary: Central chilled-water solutions planned around load, duty, pumping and heat rejection.
description: CES supports chilled-water plant planning and execution for buildings and processes that need dependable centralized cooling capacity.
system: Chillers, pumps, headers, valves, cooling towers or air-cooled condensers, controls and distribution piping are engineered as a complete plant network.
completeSolution: CES brings plant equipment, piping, electrical coordination, controls and commissioning together under a clear delivery sequence.

title: Clean Room Services
summary: Controlled environments designed around cleanliness, pressure, temperature and humidity requirements.
description: CES coordinates clean-room HVAC and environmental systems for spaces where contamination control and stable operating conditions are critical.
system: Air-handling, terminal filtration, return air, pressure control, room-envelope interfaces, monitoring and controls are treated as one controlled environment.
completeSolution: CES coordinates room criteria, HVAC engineering, filtration, controls, installation interfaces and performance checks from one project brief.

title: Cold Room Services
summary: Temperature-controlled rooms planned for dependable storage and practical daily operation.
description: CES develops cold-room solutions around storage temperature, product load, door usage, pull-down demand and the surrounding environment.
system: The refrigeration unit, evaporator, insulated envelope, door, drainage, electrical supply and temperature controls are coordinated as a single storage system.
completeSolution: CES connects refrigeration sizing, insulated construction, equipment placement, controls and commissioning for a ready-to-operate cold room.

title: Ductable & Packaged AC
summary: Robust unitary air-conditioning systems with coordinated duct distribution and controls.
description: CES selects and installs ductable split and packaged air-conditioning systems for spaces needing straightforward, dependable cooling distribution.
system: Indoor and outdoor units, refrigerant piping, ductwork, diffusers, return air, drainage, power and controls are coordinated for stable delivery.
completeSolution: CES handles selection, coordinated routing, installation, pressure testing, airflow checks and final commissioning.

title: VRV / VRF Systems
summary: Flexible multi-zone air conditioning with coordinated refrigerant networks and individual control.
description: CES plans VRV and VRF solutions for buildings that benefit from zone-level control, modular capacity and compact distribution routes.
system: Outdoor modules, indoor units, branch joints, refrigerant piping, condensate drainage, communication wiring and controllers operate as one network.
completeSolution: CES coordinates equipment, piping, drainage, cabling, controls, testing and manufacturer-aligned commissioning.

title: Interiors & Architecture
summary: Coordinated interior planning that integrates comfort systems with functional, presentable spaces.
description: CES aligns spatial planning, interior finishes and building services so architecture and HVAC can be executed without avoidable conflicts.
system: Planning, finishes, ceilings, lighting, electrical services, HVAC terminals and access requirements are coordinated within one interior layout.
completeSolution: CES supports the project from space planning and coordinated drawings through material decisions and site execution interfaces.
